_note: OcuScan research risk register (v0.5). ISO 14971-style structured thinking: hazard, cause, harm, severity, probability, level, mitigation, residual risk, verification. This is a research documentation layer, NOT an ISO certification claim. Severity: negligible/minor/serious/critical. Probability: rare/occasional/frequent.

risks.hazard: False reassurance (normal screen interpreted as healthy)
risks.cause: User over-trusts a normal screening result
risks.mitigation: Conservative wording everywhere; normal results always carry does-not-rule-out notice (code-enforced); disclaimers on every result surface
risks.verification: safety-language unit tests; banned-phrase scan; no-false-reassurance test

risks.mitigation: Uncertainty shown (quality/confidence); limitations listed; repeat-test + professional-assessment guidance; never disease names

risks.hazard: Silent acquisition failure (no frames, no error)
risks.cause: Stream binding failure; stale controller; swallowed exception
risks.mitigation: Explicit stage machine; first-frame watchdog; fallback configs; stale-stream rebuild; recorded errors; recovery ladder; snapshot fallback
risks.verification: pipeline unit tests (stages, watchdog, fallback, stale); lifecycle journey test

risks.cause: Mis-oriented or corrupt ML input; poor lighting/blur
risks.mitigation: Observed-layout ML construction; computed rotation; QualityGate vetoes LOW quality; unable-to-assess instead of guessing
risks.verification: transform tests; quality-gate tests; unable-path tests

risks.cause: OEM camera stack, missing Play services, low-end hardware
risks.mitigation: Capability detection; fallback configs; per-device profiles; Egypt/local device matrix; no general-compatibility claims
risks.verification: capability unit tests; device report + diagnostic export; physical matrix (needs hardware)

risks.hazard: Emergency misuse (screening used instead of urgent care)
risks.cause: User treats app as emergency triage
risks.mitigation: Independent symptom-based emergency path (no camera dependency); emergency banners in consent/movement flows; explicit do-not-rely wording
risks.verification: emergency screen journey coverage; wording review

risks.cause: Bug storing captures; export including images; logging images
risks.mitigation: Local-first; raw deletion by default; opt-in captures only; exports row-only; no network clients; no image logging; delete-all
risks.verification: privacy grep audits; delete-all tests; export-content tests

risks.hazard: Research face images kept or shared unintentionally
risks.cause: User enables captures without understanding scope
risks.mitigation: Double acknowledgment; local-only; deletable; excluded from exports; deleted with experiment/delete-all; diagnostic stills transient
risks.verification: capture lifecycle tests; export exclusion review

risks.mitigation: Module hard-disabled without a controlled safe stimulus; reports unable-to-assess; no flash ever used
risks.verification: code review (no flash APIs in screening); unable-path test

risks.cause: Wrong distance, scaling, night mode, filters
risks.possible_harm: False reassurance or alarm from bad numbers
risks.mitigation: Pre-test instruction + calibration checklists; real text-scale detection; uncalibrated results marked unable/unreliable; conditions recorded with every result
risks.verification: calibration-gate tests; staircase unit tests; journey persist test

risks.hazard: Stale or mismapped evidence misleads interpretation
risks.cause: Entry without references; outdated review; wrong linkage
risks.mitigation: Tier badges; audit page (coverage, orphans, staleness, Tier-C-shipped); every registry key mapped to an entry (tested); published numbers never presented as OcuScan performance
risks.verification: evidence linkage tests; audit tab; coverage test

risks.hazard: Research movement pattern read as neurological diagnosis
risks.mitigation: Research-track catalog only (no classifiers); outputs limited to pattern-outside-reference-distribution wording; explicit never-diagnose statements; experimental badges

risks.cause: Wrong source routed to retinal analysis
risks.mitigation: RetinalCameraSource rejects non-retinal sources by design (throws); retinal UI labeled future-hardware only
Careful MSA health wording; AR term + EN medical term pairing; measurement records stay canonical English; 17-route Arabic walkthrough test

risks.hazard: Historical results reinterpreted under new algorithm
risks.mitigation: Every row carries algorithm + evidence versions; experiments pin analyzer versions; diagnostic export includes all versions

risks.hazard: Measuring against the wrong face in a crowd
risks.cause: Multiple faces in frame; arbitrary pick
risks.mitigation: Largest face forwarded but tracker refuses with named multipleFaces state; all boxes visible in research; guidance requests one person
risks.verification: tracker multi-face unit test; guidance coverage test

risks.hazard: Temporal test silently run on a single still
risks.cause: Snapshot fallback misapplied to movement/blink/response modules
risks.mitigation: Temporal modules report unable with single-image reasons; summary labeled still-image screening; fallback explicit and reversible
risks.verification: code review of snapshot analyzer paths; journey suite green
